summary: Keep one Leeward Renewable Energy platform and reject the queued duplicate OMERS owner addition. Record ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VI as the former owner from October 28, 2015 to the September 2018 OMERS close; retain OMERS as the sole current owner at 100% through Commodore US Holding Corporation. No signed or closed outcome was found for the reported 2024 minority-stake process.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: ArcLight's exact affiliate holding allocation is not publicly disclosed.
The exact September 6, 2018 closing day is supported only by the publicly truncated TXF secondary-source excerpt; OMERS independently confirms a third-quarter 2018 entry.
No public termination notice was found for the reported 2024 minority-stake auction, but no signed buyer, closing or later owner was identified.
recommendedActions: Keep one canonical Leeward Renewable Energy, LLC platform and treat its Development, Operations, Asset Management, Turbine, project and financing entities as internal or underlying boundaries.
Do not add a duplicate OMERS ownership period; retain one active OMERS period beginning in 2018 and record the disclosed 100% chain through Commodore US Holding Corporation.
Add ArcLight Capital Partners and ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VI as the former owner from the October 28, 2015 platform formation/acquisition through the September 2018 OMERS closing.
Refresh the operating profile to more than 4 GW across 30+ operating projects and more than 30 GW across 130+ development projects, and record no pending ownership transaction.
